scope: Manual Paint editor: platform/control/state routing and GTK2 native offscreen sample

findings.cause: manual_paint_view.c deferred combo callback reread XmNselectedPosition after callback unwinding; Motif could return the previous row, leaving selectors and model/status on different contexts.
findings.change: Apply XmComboBoxCallbackStruct.item_position synchronously; combo_new uses XmZERO_BASED. Remove the deferred selection timer.

findings.cause: GTK2 paint sample uses Gtk.OffscreenWindow, but normal-session launch entered the bwrap-only private namespace guard because the host-session exception accepted XEmbed only.
findings.change: Permit a narrowly scoped GTK2 offscreen capture through the existing host-session guard, validate project/recipe/events/output under the private Theme Lab session directory, and pass --host-session-root for paint samples.

runtime.previous_window_closed: WM_DELETE sent to the Theme Lab main shell; process exited
runtime.native_sample_context: GTK2 / Botão / Normal; captured 78x34 native sample in screenshot

limits: Only the GTK2 paint sample capture route is enabled here; GTK3/GTK4 capture and other toolkit adapters remain their own work.
The 96x32 raster layer remains separate artwork and does not become a native control or automatically copy the native sample dimensions.
No theme output or installed user theme was changed.
